pages.title: Feed a Pump
pages.text: Burning Pumps consume dropped furnace fuel. Illumination Pumps consume adjacent glowstone or torches. Momentum Pumps draw power from falls. Projectile Pumps consume arrows, eggs, or snowballs that strike them.

pages.title: Wire and Rhythm
pages.text: Redstone Pumps follow a contiguous redstone-wire path, consuming powered wire along it. Their search stops at the first non-wire block. Alternating pumps vary their transfer rhythm over time.

pages.title: Shape the Network
pages.text: A powered pump pauses upward transfer. Black and Orange Manipulators refresh their reserve; powered, they still transfer Aura. Conserving Nodes send only at their own height. See $(l:aura:node_variants)Node Variants$(/l) for Manipulator and Capacitor controls.

pages.title: Power-Saver Signal
pages.text: Place a Monitor beside one pump or consumer. It checks the first adjacent supported machine: an empty pump or consumer without valid work outputs 15; a pump holding power or consumer with valid work outputs 0. Ordinary Aura Nodes are ignored; it is not an aggregate-storage meter.

pages.title: Pump Readout
pages.text: The readout shows remaining eligible seconds; these pause without a target or while redstone inhibits the pump. Nominal speed is Aura per second at a one-block rise; actual transfer varies with color mix, height, and each color's mass and ascent.

pages.title: Separate Pump Feeds
pages.text: Pumps send Aura only upward; they do not pass it sideways to another Pump. For a row of Pumps, give each one a linked input branch from a lower node.
